## Spotify Tweak

A large collection of visual and gesture customizations for the Spotify app.

- Spinning album artwork (pauses in sync with real playback state)
- Custom Now Playing banner and progress bar
- Lyrics visibility, neon background, and phantom lyric options
- Home/Search/Song view custom backgrounds
- Lyric copy, artist erase, custom gestures, shake-to-shuffle
- In-app Settings screen (accessible from Spotify's own Settings page)

- Jailbroken iOS with MobileSubstrate/ElleKit
- The Spotify app installed

## 1.4 (update)
- Home background is now drawn as a semi-transparent overlay on top of the whole feed instead of behind it — Spotify's Home tab has almost no empty space for a background to show through otherwise
- Add a HOME OPACITY slider in Settings to control how strong the overlay is

## 1.4
- Rebuild the long-press "now playing info" toast on UIWindowScene (the old libbulletin dependency never rendered anything on iOS 13+); adds album artwork with an artwork-matched background color, clear 🎵 title / 👤 artist labels, and a retry so artwork shows up on the first try
- Strip Spotify UI-only noise from the info shown (AirPlay device names, "ビデオ版あり") so the real title/artist always show
- Remove a fake hardcoded "320 kbps" and an inaccurate elapsed-time readout; only real, accurate fields are shown
- Add a Settings toggle to turn the long-press info banner on/off

## 1.2
- Fix: Home Background and Artwork Rotation (and other toggles) could show ON in Settings while not actually active — the switch defaulted to appearing ON for an unset key, but the feature code read the same unset key as OFF. Defaults are now registered explicitly so both sides agree

## 1.1
- Album artwork now pauses spinning when playback is paused, and resumes smoothly (matching the real MediaRemote playback state) instead of spinning constantly
- Rebuilt for this device's architecture/injection scheme

## 1.0
- Initial release: artwork rotation & visibility, lyrics tools, custom backgrounds, gestures, in-app settings
